comments.author: YoGolan
comments.body:
I heard about Divider EX, someone can give more infos?
Like whats the boost , if the item will have effect or will loose dura ? or can be repairable ?

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
After the release of chapter 2.5, this can be improved to Divider EX through transmutation.

The effect of this equipment is shipspeed boost which grants +10 % speed up when equiping the Divider EX.

Sad thing, this instrument has low durability and is NOT an weapon category which means not repairable through Master's Smithy Tools. Only way to repair is through World Tarot card that gives +3 dura back only, so in my opinion it can be best used for emergencies.
